summary: Verified the _id leak bug fix in /app/backend/server.py. New clean_doc() helper correctly strips MongoDB '_id' and injects 'id' as string across GET /api/seasons (list + by id), GET /api/episodes/season/{id}, GET /api/episodes/{id}, GET /api/sessions/family/{id}, and GET /api/badges. Created /app/backend/tests/test_id_leak_fix.py with 18 targeted assertions: 6 verify no '_id' leak across all affected endpoints, 3 verify pre-seeded episodes (true_false 6a78ef64fa41837ea9ac064f, ranking 6a78ef64fa41837ea9ac0650, quiz 6a78ef64fa41837ea9ac0651) still return correct mini_game.type without _id, 5 regression tests re-create+GET episodes for every mini-game type (letters, true_false, ranking, quiz, custom) confirming type and data payload are preserved, and 4 regression tests cover auth/login, family profile, progress, and admin stats. Also re-ran the two prior suites (test_mopado_bugs.py, test_minigame_types.py) — 20/20 passing. Grand total: 38/38 backend tests passing (100%). The pre-existing _id leak that was the sole failure in iteration_3 is now fully resolved.

minor.issue: Parameter typed as body 'email: EmailStr' — pre-existing, out of scope for this fix.
MiniGame.data is a free-form Dict[str, Any]; no per-type validation for quiz correct-index bounds, statements shape, etc. Pre-existing.

critical_code_review_comments: clean_doc() implementation is clean and idempotent: pops '_id' via dict comprehension and adds 'id' as string; also recursively str_object_id()s nested ObjectId values — good.
clean_doc handles None/empty dicts safely (returns as-is).
server.py is still at ~638 lines. Recommend splitting into domain modules (auth, seasons, episodes, sessions, badges, videos) before it crosses 700.
seed_data_creation: 5 TEST_ episodes + 1 TEST_ season created and deleted in-run via class-scoped teardown. No leftover data.
